title: Allow manual grouping even if "Do not group" has been chosen in the options
line: With grouping set to "Manually", you can group the windows of chosen programs from the task's context menu.
explanation: The task manager only had two grouping choices: group everything by program (with a per-program opt-out list) or group nothing. With "Do not group" the per-program grouping entry was hidden from the context menu, so there was no way to group only a few chosen programs. libtaskmanager now has a GroupManually mode that groups only the programs on a new allowlist, and the task manager uses it for its first grouping choice, renamed from "Do not group" to "Manually", with a "Group this program's windows" toggle under More in each window's context menu (middle-click "toggle grouping" works too).

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add a manual group mode with an allowlist

With grouping disabled there was no way to group just a few programs,
so the new GroupManually mode groups only the apps on a new allowlist,
which requestToggleGrouping() fills in and empties in that mode.

BUG: 434700

applets/taskmanager: allow grouping single programs manually

"Do not group" left no way to group the windows of only some programs,
so it becomes "Manually", using the new GroupManually mode, and window
context menus get a "Group this program's windows" toggle to pick them.

BUG: 434700

media.caption: Grouping set to "Do not group": the More menu of a Konsole window has no way to group it
Grouping set to "Manually": More now has "Group this program's windows"
Two Konsole windows always stay as separate buttons
After checking it, the Konsole windows are grouped into one button, Dolphin stays alone
